title: Pet Totems
description: apply totems to your pets for protection!
body:
Description

A mod that adds in totems…but for pets, so your best friends don’t fall off a cliff to their untimely demise.

Simply right click on a tamed entity to apply the totem. Pets with active totems will have their nametags highlighted in gold. Once applied, it saves your pet once from death and applies a short duration of invulnerability and regeneration.


![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17cc8ec69b2646628cf3d772890dec5b730ef3be.png)

List of vanilla pets you can use totems on:

    Wolf
    Cat
    Parrot
    Horse/Donkey/Llama/Mule

Compatible with most modded pets as well (if it implements OwnableEntity it should work).
